releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Smart Reminder and Personal Calendar alarm scheduling now continues when full-screen UI permission is unavailable; Android may still restrict full-screen wake display. Existing Private Locker and Diary Lock features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 288: Check for Update is refreshed alongside My Diary 1.0.189, which contains the Smart Reminder and Personal Calendar native alarm-scheduling permission fallback. Existing web features and saved data are preserved.
